BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse is serving up serious value with their $13 Pizookie® Meal Deal, available Monday through Friday. This weekday special lets you choose from eight flavorful brewhouse entrees, each crafted with the quality and creativity BJ’s is known for. To make the deal even sweeter, every meal comes with one of our signature Personal Pizookies®; freshly- baked and perfect for a solo indulgence. Want to start your meal off right? Get a starter salad, or chips and salsa for just $4 more. Whether you're grabbing a quick lunch or planning an easy dinner out, this offer delivers an unbeatable combination of variety, quality, and value. Treat yourself to a complete meal without overspending, and make your weekdays a little more satisfying with this crave-worthy deal from BJ’s.
